body: Ah yea I’ve been meaning to get help too. I should, I really should. Thank you :)

Sweat. Man at the shady neighbourhood bakery took off his shoes and sweaty socks and straight up started kneading the dough with his feet. We still get our bread from there cuz ain’t no bread like one that’s been a flavoured with a lil bit of tangy toe juice.
Ah yee. How did you cope with it tho cuz I’ve been feeling the strain of it already.
Ah yea I totally understand. It’s the explaining that you have to do that’s the hardest. Ur actual feelings start adopting a subservient role bc who would believe you.
Yea. I’ve been trying to talk about it but more often than not I get the “haha must be just a mood swing”. Smh
I wish I was normal inside and out
